DB_TYPE.description: Database engine: postgres for production, sqlite for local dev

PG_HOSTNAME.description: PostgreSQL server hostname (internal to the Railway network)

PG_PORT.description: Port the PostgreSQL server is listening on

PG_DATABASE.description: Name of the PostgreSQL database to connect to

PG_USERNAME.description: Username for the PostgreSQL database connection

PG_PASSWORD.description: Password for the PostgreSQL database user (auto-generated by Railway)

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Keycloak admin username for the master realm (used only on first startup)

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Keycloak admin password (auto-generated by Railway, used only on first startup)

KC_PROXY.description: Keycloak proxy mode: edge, passthrough, or reencrypt

KC_HTTP_ENABLED.description: Enable plain HTTP listener alongside HTTPS (true/false)

KEYCLOAK_HOSTNAME.description: Public hostname URL that Keycloak generates links with — must match your Railway URL

PORT.description: Port the service listens on inside the container
